Bengaluru, India – 23rd October 2026 
Titan Company Limited will announce financial results (standalone and consolidated) for the quarter 
ended 30th September 2026 on Thursday, 5th November 2026. The results will be available at  
https://www.titancompany.in/investors/investor-relations/quarterly-results 
 
Earnings call at 6:00 pm India Standard Time (IST) on Thursday, 5th November 2026 
Company will host an audio conference call for 60 minutes at 6:00 pm IST on 5th November 2026 
with the senior management to discuss the results performance followed by a Q&A session. The 
audio recording and call transcript will be made available on the Company’s website.
